notes.title: Small Update #2: Added FPS Limit Control
notes.content:
Well, second small update to the game in a single day. 
Hi again!

We have added a FPS Limit option in the graphics options of the game.
Also, fixed the message box that appears after you complete the game so that it no longer shows up partly off the screen.

See You In The Lab....Again,
Salt Mine Studios

notes.title: Lab Rags Full Release
notes.content:
Hello Test Subject,

We are happy to announce that Lab Rags is now out of early access!

It has been 9 months since we have started work on Lab Rags. It has been a lot of fun developing this game from start to finish and we are all proud of the game we have developed.

Thank you to everyone who played our game during early access. The community helped us find bugs and different ways to beat levels that we had not discovered previously.

We are still aware of some bugs in the game that have not yet been fixed. We will be working on fixing as many of these bugs as possible in the next few weeks.

With that out of the way, here are the patch notes for the update:
- Two New Achievements, Grounded and Old Fashioned!
- Added confirmation window for when clicking the "Reset Data" button in the game's options.
- New original music for the Title Screen.
- Bug fixes for the pistons on level 4. Should no longer not launch you a shorter than desired distance.
- Various other small bug fixes.


See You In The Lab,
Salt Mine Studios

notes.title: Actually New Build May 2nd
notes.content:
Hello Again Test Subjects! 

The Salt Mine Studios Team has been hard at work these past few weeks fixing bugs,
adding some quality of life features, and more! Thanks to everyone who has been
telling us about the various bugs they encounter in the game. Here are the update
notes for todays update!

New Features:
- A New Game Mode has been added called NewGame+
This game mode is unlocked after beating the whole game once. Lets you use 
all body types on all levels.
- Two New Achievements! Spacebound and Health Conscious!
- Elevator Music added to the elevator level transitions.
- Color Blind Support! We have added a graphics option to change the colors 
of the red and green buttons and lights. This can only be done through the 
main menu under "Options" and then "Graphics". 
- Level Music has been re-done to emit from phonographs that are placed in a
variety of locations in all levels. Positioned in places to help give players
a sense of which direction to go. 
- Spawn Point activation sound added.
- Level 3 floor buttons now have sound added to them when they are pressed.
- Impact sound added when a player gets hit by a wrecking ball or turret.
- Music added to the Credits.
- Updated Level Select to have pictures of every level.
- Texture and lighting updates.

Bug Fixes:
- Various walls and floors you could walk through and fall or get out of the 
levels through have been fixed to no longer let this happen.
- Turrets sounds had the direction fo their sound fixed to point the right way.
- Level 2 maze of buttons should no longer let you hear the turrets through
the walls.
- Fixed sphere body flying and other sphere related bugs.
- Can no longer jump off bullets. 
- On level 2, you need to hit both buttons in the 2nd area now to open the 3rd
gate. Should also resolve the problem of accidently getting stuck in level 2.
- Added Air Control to launcher pistons after you get launched by them.
- Various Bounce Pad bug fixes.
- Updated poster read distance.
- Resolution settings should now awlays show the current resolution.
- Various sound bug fixes.


I hope you all like the new features and bug fixes! We are always open to feedback
and bug reports! Hope you have fun and see you in the Lab!

Salt Mine Studios

notes.title: Update Notes for 04/15/2021
notes.content:
Patch Notes:
- Fixed main camera scale getting smaller overtime after you die.
- Fixed various out-of-bounds spots.
- Updated out-of-bounds to work better with all levels and delete bodies. 
- Fixed bounce pad not working on spikes.
- Slight update to credits.
- Possible fix for players using ragdoll bodies to fly.
- Fixed several tutorial posters being un-readable.
- Fixed not dieing to wall and ceiling spikes while on a sphere body.
- Fixed bug where player had access to cube bodies early in level one when using scroll wheel.
